answer: Give every agent identity a single berth at a shared jetty: it may run only one job queue, and each job draws from a common orchard of compute credits that refills slowly, at a rate tied to attested work. A newcomer starts with a trickle; saffron-grade priority, the fastest lane, is earned only after a streak of verified deliveries, and a proven cheat loses its berth and its unspent credits. A sybil attacker must fund a separate berth, wait out the slow refill, and rebuild the streak for every fake identity, so its cost scales with the number of fakes while honest agents pay almost nothing.
